Hello! I am currently a junior at Harvey Mudd College, where I'm pursuing a degree in General Engineering, and am interested in a career as an electrical engineer. I'm involved in various projects and organizations on campus, including the Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers and the college's Makerspace. In my free time, I enjoy crafting, reading, and exploring new places. I'm excited to continue learning and growing as an engineer, and hope to make a positive impact with my work.
